name: How should I prepare my home for trim and molding installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home for trim and molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a finish carpenter arrives, clear a path along the walls and move furniture to the center of the room or into another space entirely. Measure the room dimensions if you need a ballpark estimate, and collect photos of casing, baseboard, or crown profiles you prefer. It is also helpful to note any known issues, such as past water leaks, drafty baseplates, or uneven floors. Clearing floor areas allows the crew to snap chalk lines, identify wall studs, and cut long pieces of lumber without damaging household items.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from walls, clear hallways for long trim boards, choose your trim profile, and point out any past wall damage or uneven flooring to your contractor.
